### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or operational bottleneck is (e.g. *"I'm always frustrated when..."*).

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the AI agent / operating system should handle it.

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Architectural or UI Mockups
If applicable, outline how this feature could fit into the existing Next.js App Router, Electron IPC, or Business Dashboard tabs.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, API documentation links, or examples here.
